pilots.status: Rejected by preliminary fidelity and realism review
pilots.finding: The tooth-to-body width is close to the reference. The unsupported, rigid upright handles fail the realism check. Independent scores were not assigned.

Both straps contact a visible peg. The navy tooth is about 22 percent of the visible bag body width in the comparison and the centered lettering appears legible. Check exact artwork, true color, product shape, and whether the vendor studio asset qualifies as an actual studio photograph before assigning scores. The scene is styled with coastal dune vegetation and does not claim a precise location.

toteBatch.sourceAudit: Eight Shopify variants matched the live merchant endpoint. The Natural Fourthwall source was identified on the public merchant gallery. Three printed tote galleries reuse identical model poses and backgrounds across separately decorated products. Gallery metadata does not establish a photographed finished sample.
toteBatch.originalPhotoSearch: The connected ShoreList Creative Library Original Photos folder was empty. Targeted image searches for Megalodon, Sea Turtle, Airlie Oak and tote returned no matches.
toteBatch.releaseStatus: No image pair cleared independent review. No approved reviews or numeric scores were entered.
